name: kiki-v42
description: Orchestrate Vibe42 remote Computers, coding Agent seats, COW workspace copies, persistent remote desktop and mobile screens, and TCP port tunnels with leased-seat visibility and CUA Provider Bus v1 integration.
author: Kiki

interface.shortDescription: Remote coding seats, COW copies, desktop/mobile screens, and port tunnels

zh-CN.shortDescription: 跨设备编码工位、COW 隔离副本、远程桌面与真机屏幕协同

systemPrompt: Use the v42-fleet skill when orchestrating remote Vibe42 Computers, coding seats, COW workspace copies, remote desktops, mobile devices, or port forwards. Prefer v42_fleet to inspect online Computers and leased seats; v42_seat_run to dispatch/steer/pin seats; v42_seat_inspect with since_cursor for incremental updates; v42_seat_resolve only for non-privileged questions or COW copy actions (never attempt to self-approve remote approval/login prompts; ask the user to approve in the Vibe42 Workbench panel); and v42_env_transfer for cp/sync, screenshots, and port tunnels. Respect 409 human_controlling takeover locks unless the user explicitly asks to override.

v42BinPath.title: v42 CLI Path
v42BinPath.description: Optional explicit path to the v42 executable. Leave empty to auto-discover the installed Vibe42 Companion binary and signed-in session.

zh-CN.title: v42 CLI 路径
zh-CN.description: 可选显式指定 v42 可执行文件路径；留空时自动发现本机已安装的 Vibe42 Companion 与已登录会话。

companionRoot.title: Vibe42 Companion Root
companionRoot.description: Optional explicit Vibe42 Companion install directory passed via --companion-root. Leave empty for automatic cross-platform discovery.

zh-CN.title: Vibe42 Companion 根目录
zh-CN.description: 可选显式指定传递给 --companion-root 的 Companion 安装目录；留空时跨平台自动探测。

gatewayEndpoint.title: Structured AgentView Bridge
gatewayEndpoint.description: Optional loopback HTTP endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) for structured AgentView streaming; falls back to v42 CLI.

zh-CN.title: 结构化 AgentView 桥接端点
zh-CN.description: 可选本地回环 HTTP 端点（http://127.0.0.1:<port>）；未配置时自动使用 v42 CLI。

autoWaitMs.title: Auto Wait Window (ms)
autoWaitMs.description: Wait window in milliseconds for v42_seat_run wait_mode='auto' before returning a background working receipt.

zh-CN.title: 自动等待窗口（毫秒）
zh-CN.description: v42_seat_run 在 auto 模式下等待远端回合落定的毫秒上限，超时后转后台回执。

cuaExposeAllOnline.title: Expose All Online Screens to CUA Bus
cuaExposeAllOnline.description: Include all online Vibe42 desktops and mobile devices in kiki.cua.provider.v1 /v1/targets even before pinning.

zh-CN.title: 向 CUA 总线暴露全部在线屏幕
zh-CN.description: 在 kiki.cua.provider.v1 的 /v1/targets 中同时列出在线远程桌面与手机屏幕。

tools.name: v42_fleet
tools.description: Discover Vibe42 Computers, Workspaces, coding seats, mobile devices, workspace memos, and active loopback port forwards. Read-only discovery across managed leases and optional unmanaged seats.

scope.description: Resource view to inspect across the Vibe42 fleet.

computer.description: Optional Computer ID or name filter; omit to inspect all Computers in the active Team.

workspace.description: Optional Workspace ID or name filter.

status_filter.description: Filter seats by current execution state.

include_unmanaged.description: Include active remote seats and devices not yet leased or pinned to this Kiki session.

tools.name: v42_seat_run
tools.description: Create, dispatch, steer, interrupt, configure, pin, or unpin a remote Vibe42 coding seat (or remote desktop/mobile target). Waits up to 25s by default in auto mode before returning a deterministic background receipt with seat_ref and cursor. Respects active human takeover leases.

seat_ref.description: Target reference: "<computer>:<terminalId>" for a seat, "<computer>:desktop" for a remote desktop, or "<computer>:mobile:<deviceId>" for a mobile target.

expected_session.description: Optional expected remote agent session ID; fails with session_changed if the seat rotated sessions.

computer.description: Computer ID or name when dispatching a new seat or pinning a target.

workspace.description: Workspace ID or name on the target Computer.

cwd.description: Working directory on the target Computer when not using a named Workspace.

agent.description: Coding agent launcher for newly created seats.

isolated_copy.description: Run the new seat inside a copy-on-write isolated workspace copy when supported.

title.description: Display title for a newly opened or pinned seat.

prompt.description: Self-contained task assignment or follow-up instruction for dispatch/steer.

steer_mode.description: Mid-turn delivery mode: interject for Codex/OMP or queue for sequential turns.

items.description: Workspace-relative or approved local file path to upload and attach to the prompt.

local_attachments.description: Local files staged to the remote Computer before sending the prompt.

wait_mode.description: auto waits up to 25s streaming progress before returning a background receipt; async returns immediately; turn waits up to 120s.

kind.description: Seat runtime parameter or compaction trigger.

value.description: Target model ID, effort level, mode name, or compaction note.

control.description: Control payload used when action is "control".

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key deduplicated in the 64-slot ring buffer to prevent duplicate prompt injection on retry.

override_human_lease.description: Only set true when the user explicitly instructed overriding an active human takeover lock.

tools.name: v42_seat_inspect
tools.description: Inspect structured AgentView turns, transcript rows, folded output tokens, subagent traces, media artifacts, copy-on-write diffs, or live terminal screen lines for a Vibe42 seat.

since_cursor.description: Monotonic cursor from an earlier receipt for incremental turn or row reads.

limit.description: Maximum turns, rows, or terminal scrollback lines to return.

subagent_id.description: Remote subagent identifier when mode is "subagent".

media_id.description: Remote media artifact identifier or path when mode is "media".

copy_id.description: Optional isolated copy number or directory when mode is "copy_diff".

path.description: Optional relative file path when inspecting a specific file diff in mode "copy_diff".

tools.name: v42_seat_resolve
tools.description: Answer non-privileged technical questions on a blocked Vibe42 seat or manage its copy-on-write isolated workspace copy. Security rule: approval and login requests can never be approved by the model and require human action in the Vibe42 Workbench.

expected_session.description: Optional expected remote agent session ID.

pending_id.description: Identifier of the pending question interaction on the seat.

kind.description: Allowed model resolution kinds. Privileged approvals are intentionally excluded.

answers.description: Question key to selected answer(s) map when kind is "answers".

resolution.description: Structured response for a non-privileged pending question.

copy_message.description: Snapshot note for save_snapshot or branch/commit context for push.

copy_branch.description: Target Git branch name when copy_action is "push".

copy_id.description: Optional isolated copy number or directory.

tools.name: v42_env_transfer
tools.description: Transfer or synchronize files between the local workspace and a remote Vibe42 Computer, capture remote desktop or mobile screenshots, and start, stop, or list loopback port-forward tunnels.

action.description: Cross-device file, visual capture, or loopback tunnel action.

computer.description: Target Vibe42 Computer ID or name.

local_path.description: Workspace-relative or approved absolute local file/directory path for pull, push, or sync_to_remote.

remote_path.description: Absolute path on the remote Computer for pull, push, or sync_to_remote.

mobile_device_id.description: Mobile device ID (for example "adb:serial" or simulator UDID) for mobile_screenshot.

window_id.description: Optional remote desktop window ID from desktop windows discovery.

remote_port.description: Remote loopback TCP port on the Computer for port_forward_start or port_forward_stop.

local_port.description: Optional local loopback TCP port on 127.0.0.1; auto-allocated when omitted.
